originalTitle: How Equinix has found a niche in the multitrillion-dollar AI data center boom
summary: Nvidia announced a new data center deal with Equinix and Together AI on Wednesday to help enterprise customers with open-model inference.
content:
Long before the era of the hyperscalers and neoclouds, and decades ahead of the AI data center boom, there was Equinix .

Described as a colocation facility, Equinix provides data center space for over 10,500 customers, offering space, power, cooling and security for companies that need a place to house their servers, routers and storage systems.

That experience, dating back to the 1998 dot-com bonanza, has given Equinix an important and expanding role in the artificial intelligence data center market, where hyperscalers are expected to spend over $5 trillion by 2030, according to Goldman Sachs Research . On Wednesday, Equinix inked a deal with Nvidia that gives customers a flexible way to run their AI models on open-source cloud platform Together AI.

Equinix's stock price is up 33% this year, beating all of megacap tech and lifting the company's market cap to $100 billion. It's by far the most valuable data center real estate investment trust (REIT), ahead of Digital Realty, which has a market cap of $68 billion.

Hyperscalers like Amazon and Google , and neoclouds like CoreWeave are collectively spending hundreds of billions of dollars a year on infrastructure, with an outsized amount of that going to serve major AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic. Equinix, by contrast, rents out space in its facilities to customers of all shapes and sizes that can run servers on a variety of compute platforms, from Nvidia to AMD .

At an event in San Francisco, California, on Wednesday tied to the Nvidia deal, the chipmaker's CEO, Jensen Huang, spoke by video with Equinix CEO Adaire Fox-Martin. Huang said that the location of Equinix's facilities allow you to be "close to where the action is, where all the sensors are." And because the architecture is distributed, "you could both simultaneously be close and be far away," he said.

Equinix is one of the oldest names in the data center business. Its 281 legacy colocation facilities span 77 metropolitan areas across six continents, according to Maryam Zand, a vice president at the company who runs its AI ecosystem strategy.

"The companies you already use are all running on us," she says.

Financing details for Wednesday's deal weren't disclosed. Zand said Together AI, which offers access to 200 open-source models, will be the seller of record, billing its end customers who use the new program. Called Equinix Inference Exchange, it will be available in the first quarter of 2027.

While AI training teaches the model to learn from patterns in large amounts of data, inference refers to the decisions that are made based on new information. As AI evolves from simple call-and-answer chatbots to more complex agentic apps, inference has become more critical than training. That means workloads need to run on a wider variety of chips such as central processing units (CPUs), instead of relying solely on general-purpose workhorse graphics processing units (GPUs).

Equinix has mainly stuck to its old playbook of building smaller data centers in locations close to city centers, positioning them as network interconnection hubs. Digital Realty , by contrast, began to place greater emphasis on large-scale facilities for hyperscale customers.

For xScale, the side of Equinix's business that serves hyperscalers, most facilities are on the smaller side. They're under 100 megawatts, while some AI data centers are being measured in the gigawatts.

Vlad Galabov, a longtime data center analyst, said Equinix was "too slow" to react to the gigawatt-scale demand.

"There was new, hungrier guys who came in to start to build data centers for some of these burst projects that just quickly spun up," said Galabov, host of the AIDC Debate podcast. "Equinix, Digital Realty, all of the colocation companies are now seeing the need to plan more strategically."

Equinix's announcements Wednesday also included Equinix Fabric One , a new connectivity service meant to simplify networks that operate using multiple clouds and AI models.

Zand described the announced program with Nvidia and Together AI as an "inference platform as a service," that enables customers to connect to a variety of different clouds and providers, run inference on open source models, and "optimize their tokenomics" — or reduce costs.

She told CNBC that Equinix data centers are optimized for Nvidia's B300 Blackwell Ultra GPUs, but it also has some liquid-cooled facilities where customers can use the newer Vera Rubin chips.

Where Equinix has a particular advantage is its urban locations, which are important for inference and the high-speed communication required between servers and end users. By 2030, inference will make up half of all AI compute and 30% to 40% of total data center demand, according to McKinsey .

"The changes are very rapid in today's environment, in the whole AI ecosystem," Zand said. "Customers need to be able to move as the market moves."

Not all investors are excited about the story.

Short seller Jim Chanos told CNBC's "Closing Bell" in May that he was betting against the stock, as well as Digital Realty, saying "they're not great businesses" and are "not very profitable."

"They're very low return on capital businesses, very capital-intensive businesses, and they don't grow that fast," he said.

He added that, "the legacy data center companies are a distinct difference from the data centers that are being built for AI."

In the latest quarter , Equinix reported a 16% increase in revenue from a year earlier to $2.63 billion. CoreWeave , one of the leading neoclouds, saw revenue more than double to $2.58 billion. However, Equinix reported net income of $477 million in the period, while CoreWeave lost $626 million.

Galabov said Equinix is "super diversified" with a huge amount of general purpose compute and services across a very wide client base.

chineseTitle: Equinix 如何在价值数万亿美元的 AI 数据中心热潮中找到一席之地
chineseSummary: Nvidia 周三宣布与 Equinix 和 Together AI 达成新的数据中心协议，以帮助企业客户进行开放模型推理。
chineseContent:
早在超大规模和新云时代出现之前，在人工智能数据中心繁荣之前几十年，Equinix 就已经出现了。

Equinix 被称为托管设施，为超过 10,500 家客户提供数据中心空间，为需要安置服务器、路由器和存储系统的公司提供空间、电力、冷却和安全保障。

这段经历可以追溯到 1998 年互联网泡沫时期，它使 Equinix 在人工智能数据中心市场中发挥着重要且不断扩大的作用，据高盛研究公司称，到 2030 年，超大规模企业预计将在该市场花费超过 5 万亿美元。周三，Equinix 与 Nvidia 签署了一项协议，为客户提供了一种灵活的方式，在开源云平台 Together AI 上运行他们的人工智能模型。

Equinix 的股价今年上涨了 33%，超过了所有大型科技股，并将该公司的市值提升至 1000 亿美元。它是迄今为止最有价值的数据中心房地产投资信托基金 (REIT)，领先于市值 680 亿美元的 Digital Realty。

亚马逊和谷歌等超大规模企业以及 CoreWeave 等新云每年总共在基础设施上花费数千亿美元，其中大量资金将用于为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等主要人工智能实验室提供服务。相比之下，Equinix 将其设施中的空间出租给各种类型和规模的客户，这些客户可以在各种计算平台（从 Nvidia 到 AMD）上运行服务器。

周三，在加利福尼亚州旧金山举行的与 Nvidia 交易相关的活动上，该芯片制造商的首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 通过视频与 Equinix 首席执行官阿代尔·福克斯-马丁 (Adaire Fox-Martin) 进行了交谈。黄说，Equinix 设施的位置让您可以“靠近行动地点、所有传感器所在的位置”。由于架构是分布式的，“你可以同时靠近和远离，”他说。

Equinix 是数据中心行业最古老的品牌之一。该公司负责人工智能生态系统战略的副总裁玛丽亚姆·赞德 (Maryam Zand) 表示，其 281 个遗留托管设施遍布六大洲的 77 个大都市地区。

“你们已经使用的公司都在依赖我们，”她说。

周三交易的融资细节尚未披露。 Zand 表示，Together AI 提供 200 个开源模型的访问权限，将成为记录销售商，向使用新程序的最终客户收取费用。它被称为 Equinix Inference Exchange，将于 2027 年第一季度推出。

虽然人工智能训练教会模型从大量数据中的模式中学习，但推理是指根据新信息做出的决策。随着人工智能从简单的呼叫和应答聊天机器人发展到更复杂的代理应用程序，推理变得比训练更加重要。这意味着工作负载需要在更广泛的芯片上运行，例如中央处理单元 (CPU)，而不是仅仅依赖于通用主力图形处理单元 (GPU)。

Equinix 主要坚持其旧策略，即在靠近市中心的位置建立较小的数据中心，将其定位为网络互连中心。相比之下，Digital Realty 开始更加重视为超大规模客户提供大型设施。

对于 xScale（Equinix 为超大规模企业提供服务的业务部门）来说，大多数设施都位于较小的一侧。它们的功耗低于 100 兆瓦，而一些人工智能数据中心的测量单位为千兆瓦。

长期数据中心分析师 Vlad Galabov 表示，Equinix 对千兆瓦级需求的反应“太慢”。

AIDC 辩论播客主持人加拉波夫 (Galabov) 表示：“有一些新的、更渴望的人加入进来，开始为其中一些快速启动的突发项目构建数据中心。” “Equinix、Digital Realty 以及所有托管公司现在都意识到需要进行更具战略性的规划。”

Equinix 周三发布的公告还包括 Equinix Fabric One，这是一项新的连接服务，旨在简化使用多个云和人工智能模型运行的网络。

Zand 将与 Nvidia 和 Together AI 宣布的计划描述为“推理平台即服务”，使客户能够连接到各种不同的云和提供商，在开源模型上运行推理，并“优化他们的代币经济学”——或降低成本。

她告诉 CNBC，Equinix 数据中心针对 Nvidia 的 B300 Blackwell Ultra GPU 进行了优化，但它也有一些液冷设施，客户可以在其中使用较新的 Vera Rubin 芯片。

Equinix 的独特优势在于其城市位置，这对于推理以及服务器和最终用户之间所需的高速通信非常重要。据麦肯锡预测，到 2030 年，推理将占所有人工智能计算的一半，占数据中心总需求的 30% 至 40%。

“在当今的环境中，在整个人工智能生态系统中，变化非常迅速，”赞德说。 “客户需要能够随着市场的变化而变化。”

并非所有投资者都对这个故事感到兴奋。

卖空者吉姆·查诺斯 (Jim Chanos) 在 5 月份的 CNBC 节目“收盘钟”节目中表示，他做空该股以及 Digital Realty 的股票，称“它们不是伟大的企业”，而且“利润不是很高”。

“它们是资本回报率非常低的企业，是资本密集型企业，而且增长速度不那么快，”他说。

他补充说，“传统数据中心公司与为人工智能构建的数据中心有着明显的区别。”

最新季度，Equinix 报告收入较上年同期增长 16%，达到 26.3 亿美元。 CoreWeave 是领先的新云之一，收入增长了一倍多，达到 25.8 亿美元。然而，Equinix 报告期内净利润为 4.77 亿美元，而 CoreWeave 亏损 6.26 亿美元。

Galabov 表示，Equinix 是“超级多元化”的公司，拥有大量通用计算和服务，覆盖非常广泛的客户群。

“他们没有面临人工智能泡沫风险，”加拉博夫说。 “这意味着你错过了一些繁荣。这是不可避免的。高风险，高回报
